column1: # OpenAPI 3.x and Swagger 2.0 counters, YAML or JSON, for a rule with the prompt file-body-contract:
# one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). The [ignore] line blanks YAML comments (a whole line,
# or from a # after a blank) and the body of a block scalar (| or > and the lines indented below it),
# so a description that quotes a path or a "type: object" does not count. A key counts with or
# without JSON quotes, so a minified JSON spec counts too. "operations" counts a get, put, post,
# delete, options, head, patch or trace key that opens a mapping; "parameters (approx)" an in: of
# one of the six locations, which an apiKey security scheme's in: (header, query or cookie) is too.
# OpsFactPatternsTest pins every case; ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern
